actions.title: List a directory on the VPS
actions.description: List a directory on the VPS; returns each entry's name and type. Call this FIRST to discover a path — guessing one wastes a call. The size field is always 0 and is NOT a real size, so never conclude a file is empty from it. Reads are bounded to the server's allowed roots and credential paths are refused.

path.description: Absolute path on the VPS, or ~/… for the owner's home.

actions.title: Read a text file on the VPS
actions.description: Return the contents of a text file on the VPS. Binary files come back as garbage — check the extension via mso.fs.list first. This is not how you FIND a file; use mso.fs.search for that. Rated above the other reads because it returns file contents rather than metadata.

path.description: Absolute path on the VPS, or ~/… for the owner's home.

actions.title: Find a directory by name
actions.description: Find DIRECTORIES whose name contains a fragment, recursively, under a root. Use it to locate a project folder before mso.fs.list. It does NOT match file names or file contents.

root.description: Where to search from. Defaults to ~/projects.

actions.title: Disk usage for a path
actions.description: Total, used and free bytes for a path on the VPS. This is the cheap answer to "is the VPS full?".

path.description: Absolute path on the VPS, or ~/… for the owner's home.

actions.title: Live VPS health
actions.description: CPU load, memory, disk and uptime for the VPS in one call. Use this for "how is the server doing" rather than reading files or asking for a shell.

actions.title: Top processes by CPU
actions.description: Top processes by CPU with pid, command, cpu% and memory%. Use it to find what is eating the box.

actions.title: List managed applications
actions.description: List the applications mso can install and control on this VPS, with their install and running state. These are server-side daemons, not the mso desktop UI surfaces. Call this before mso.apps.logs or mso.apps.power to get valid ids.

actions.title: Read a managed application's logs
actions.description: Recent log output for one managed application. This is the right way to answer "why is X down" — the same question through a shell would need far more trust. Get valid ids from mso.apps.list.

id.description: Managed app id from mso.apps.list, e.g. hermes.

actions.title: Anti-fingerprinting browser status
actions.description: Whether the Camoufox browser is installed, running and set to autostart. The viewer URL and its VNC password are deliberately NOT returned — that session holds live logins, so its credentials never leave the box in a tool result.

actions.title: Write a text file on the VPS
actions.description: Create or overwrite a text file on the VPS. It OVERWRITES WITHOUT WARNING and there is no undo — read the file with mso.fs.read first if the old contents matter. Bounded to the server's writable roots.

path.description: Absolute path on the VPS, or ~/… for the owner's home.

content.description: Full new contents of the file.

actions.title: Create a directory on the VPS
actions.description: Create a directory on the VPS, including any missing parents. Safe to repeat: an existing directory is not an error.

path.description: Absolute path on the VPS, or ~/… for the owner's home.

actions.title: Move or rename on the VPS
actions.description: Move or rename a file or directory on the VPS. The old path stops existing, so anything referring to it breaks — confirm with the user before moving something you did not create. Refused when the source holds credential paths.

actions.title: Copy a file or directory
actions.description: Copy a file or directory on the VPS. The cockpit's own secrets are skipped rather than duplicated.

actions.title: Delete a file or directory
actions.description: Delete a file or directory on the VPS. PERMANENT — there is no trash and no undo, and a directory goes with everything inside it. Confirm with the user before calling this on anything you did not create in this conversation.

path.description: Absolute path on the VPS, or ~/… for the owner's home.

actions.title: Start, stop, restart or back up an app
actions.description: Start, stop, restart or back up a managed application on the VPS. Restarting or stopping one CUTS OFF whatever is currently using it — sessions in flight are lost, so say which app and which verb before calling. Check mso.apps.list or mso.apps.logs first.
